title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Poland
notice: ঢাকায় কোনো Polish Embassy নেই। ভিসার জন্য New Delhi (India) যেতে হবে — আগে Indian Visa নিন।

processSteps.label: University Application : via university portal or study.gov.pl
bullets: Most universities have their own portal (e.g. apply.uw.edu.pl, rekrutacja.agh.edu.pl, kozminski.edu.pl)
Application window: January–June for October intake
Application fee: €0–€50 (public universities); up to €200 (some private)

processSteps.label: Admission / Offer Letter
bullets: Bachelor's: €500–€6,000/year | Master's: €1,000–€8,000/year | Medical: €8,000–€15,000+/year
State universities may offer Polish-taught programs at very low or no cost
Private universities (Kozminski, Lazarski, Vistula) offer more English-medium options

processSteps.label: NAWA Syrena Verification : mandatory since 1 July 2025
bullets: Apply online at syrena.nawa.gov.pl — completely free
Upload your admission letter and program details
Receive a Syrena Confirmation Letter — required for visa application
Can be completed from Dhaka; no travel needed for this step

processSteps.label: Apostille Your Documents : MoFA Dhaka (Bangladesh joined Hague Convention 30 March 2025)
bullets: Degree Certificate, Transcript — and possibly Birth Certificate — may need Apostille
MoFA (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) Apostille is sufficient — no separate Embassy legalization needed
Ask your university exactly which documents need Apostille

processSteps.label: Prepare Financial Proof : Credit Card with min 10,912 PLN limit
bullets: Polish Embassy New Delhi does NOT accept Bangladeshi bank solvency statements
Required: credit card with minimum limit of 10,912 PLN (701 PLN × 12 months + 2,500 PLN)
Sponsor's credit card accepted with Affidavit of Support

processSteps.label: Fill Visa Form on e-Konsulat Portal
bullets: Complete application at secure2.e-konsulat.gov.pl — handwritten forms NOT accepted
Print the completed form and sign before submission
Book appointment at VFS Global India (New Delhi) after completing the form

processSteps.label: Travel to New Delhi — Submit at VFS Global India
bullets: Obtain Indian Visa first — required to enter India for Poland visa submission
Submit documents + biometrics at VFS Global India, New Delhi
VFS India Email: info.polandin@vfshelpline.com
Visa fee: €200 (effective January 2026) | Processing: 2–8 weeks (legal max 30 days)

processSteps.label: Arrive in Poland — Register & Get PESEL
bullets: Register your address at Voivodeship Office (Urząd Wojewódzki) within 30 days of arrival
Obtain PESEL (personal ID number) — required for banking, work, healthcare
Enrol at university and obtain student ID

processSteps.label: Apply for Karta Pobytu (Residence Card) : at least 45 days before visa expires
bullets: Apply at Voivodeship Office via MOS portal online (digital since 1 January 2026)
Fee: PLN 440 (~€103 total)
Processing: 4–6 months; a temporary sticker/stamp is issued while waiting
Needed: university enrollment certificate, accommodation proof, health insurance, financial proof

costSteps.label: NAWA Syrena Verification : Free — online at syrena.nawa.gov.pl
MoFA Apostille : per document — check current MoFA fee schedule
Indian Visa : required to travel to New Delhi for Poland visa submission
Polish National D Visa Fee : €200 (from January 2026) — paid at VFS India
VFS Global India Service Fee : check vfsglobal.com/Poland/India for current fee
University Application Fee : €0–€200 depending on university
Dormitory / First Month Rent : 500–2,500 PLN — varies by city and university
Karta Pobytu (Residence Card) : PLN 440 (~€103) — paid after arrival
Air Ticket to Poland : varies by season and route
